description: Train one normalized positive reward component at a time. All dense deltas, explicit penalties, and Lagrangian training penalties are disabled so learnability can be attributed to that component.

common.reward_normalization: All raw component scores are bounded or normalized by the environment. Each screening case gives its only active positive component coefficient 1.0.

cases.label: Throughput only
cases.hypothesis: Measures how quickly PPO learns spectral efficiency without any fairness or safety signal.

cases.label: Jain fairness only
cases.hypothesis: Tests whether the cell-level Jain score provides sufficient credit for per-UE scheduling.

cases.label: Service only
cases.hypothesis: Tests whether broad successful-service coverage is easy for PPO to optimize.

cases.label: Throughput-deficit service only
cases.hypothesis: Tests whether serving below-average UEs gives denser fairness credit than Jain fairness.

cases.label: PF utility only
cases.hypothesis: Tests proportional-fair utility as a standalone throughput-fairness signal.

cases.label: Low-percentile throughput only
cases.hypothesis: Tests whether direct pressure on the bottom-throughput group improves fairness.

cases.label: Urgency service only
cases.hypothesis: Tests whether serving high-wait UEs is sufficient to learn a stable service cycle.
